title: Uganda is wiring up South Sudan

head: ONLY 1 IN 20
HAS ELECTRICITY
scenes.say: In South Sudan, only about one in twenty people has electricity. That could be about to change.
scenes.show: In South Sudan, only about 1 in 20 people has electricity. That could be about to change.

head: UGANDA IS
PLUGGING IN
scenes.say: Uganda has started building a high-voltage power line to its northern neighbour.
scenes.show: Uganda has started building a high-voltage power line to its northern neighbour.

head: MILLION
scenes.say: It's backed by one hundred and twenty-one million dollars from the African Development Fund.
scenes.show: It's backed by $121 million from the African Development Fund.

head: 299 KM
OF POWER LINE
scenes.say: The line will run about two hundred and ninety-nine kilometres, from Olwiyo in northern Uganda, through Nimule, to Juba.
scenes.show: The line will run about 299 kilometres, from Olwiyo in northern Uganda, through Nimule, to Juba.

head: UP TO
1,000 MEGAWATTS
scenes.say: At four hundred kilovolts, it's built to carry up to one thousand megawatts.
scenes.show: At 400 kilovolts, it's built to carry up to 1,000 megawatts.

head: WHO
WINS?

ranks.text: UGANDA · A NEW MARKET NEXT DOOR

scenes.say: South Sudan gets more reliable, potentially cheaper power. Uganda gets a new market across the border.
scenes.show: South Sudan gets more reliable, potentially cheaper power. Uganda gets a new market across the border.

head: PLUGGED INTO
THE REGION
scenes.say: And South Sudan plugs into the Eastern Africa Power Pool, where countries trade electricity.
scenes.show: And South Sudan plugs into the Eastern Africa Power Pool, where countries trade electricity.

head: READY BY
scenes.say: Construction runs from twenty twenty-six to twenty twenty-nine.

head: AFRICA BUILDING
DOESN'T TREND
scenes.say: Africa building its own future rarely trends. That's the blind spot.
scenes.show: Africa building its own future rarely trends. That's the blind spot.

head: SEND THIS TO
SOMEONE WHO HASN'T HEARD
scenes.say: Send this to someone who hasn't heard.
scenes.show: Send this to someone who hasn't heard.
